description: This file contains utility functions for managing runtime plugin overlays, symbolic links, and filesystem operations related to staging plugin runtimes and their extensions. It is part of a build or setup process for packaging plugin runtimes in a project.

methods.name: symlinkType
methods.description: Determines the type of symlink based on the current platform ('junction' for Windows, 'dir' otherwise).

methods.name: relativeSymlinkTarget
methods.description: Computes a relative path from the target directory to the source path for creating symlinks.

methods.name: ensureSymlink
methods.description: Creates a symlink at a target path pointing to a target value, with logic to handle existing symlinks and recreate if necessary.

methods.name: symlinkPath
methods.description: Creates a symlink link from source to target path, using relative paths.

methods.name: shouldWrapRuntimeJsFile
methods.description: Checks if a file should be wrapped into a module by identifying '.js' extension files.

methods.name: shouldCopyRuntimeFile
methods.description: Checks if a file should be copied directly based on specific filename endings related to package and plugin configuration files.

methods.name: writeRuntimeModuleWrapper
methods.description: Writes a wrapper module that re-exports contents of another module, facilitating module wrapping.

methods.name: stagePluginRuntimeOverlay
methods.description: Recursively stages plugin runtime overlays by copying, wrapping, or symlinking files from source to target directories.

methods.name: linkPluginNodeModules
methods.description: Creates a symlink for the 'node_modules' directory of a plugin runtime.

methods.name: stageBundledPluginRuntime
methods.description: Main exported function that coordinates the staging of plugin runtimes and their extensions, handling directory creation, cleanup, and overlay staging.
